Money minded people..

Demo session - 250 rs..
Monthly fees - 2000 rs.

If demo session goes well, 250 will be part of 2000 monthly fees

But it depends on session we do..
Weekends session (1 hour), we can do multiple sessions in a day as well.

Few days classes were organized early (we were not notified)

Also, as we were out of town, was not able to attend two weekend  sessions.

When we went there..was told to pay 2000 to continue..

We did notify into the group, this behavior of yours clearly specifies how money minded you are.

Treat yourself with remaining two sessions that is.. 500 rs from our end.
Enjoy!!

Would never recommend music planet to others...
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
There seems to be some misunderstanding. You were absent for more than a month with very infrequent attendance. I had also informed your wife regarding this. She had mentioned attending a few sessions now, and then rejoining after Diwali with no definite date. On this basis, it becomes difficult for me to plan ahead.

Please understand, I pay my tutors for every scheduled session—whether attended or not—as this is their daily livelihood. I had requested a payment of ₹2000 as the next installment, which was due from your side. I also maintain an attendance record to support this.

I believe it would have been better if you had spoken to me directly before posting anything online. That would reflect professional courtesy. Going public instead of discussing with me first does not present your intentions in the right way.

I hope you understand my position and we can resolve this matter respectfully.
